name: WESTRVR
recent: West River Berhad 近期有多项公告，包括季度业绩、董事会及委员会成员变动，以及一项清盘/接管相关公告。新闻方面，公司表示将专注于更高利润率的合约。
notable: 公司于2026年9月1日宣布多名董事及委员会成员变动，包括委任新董事及审计、提名、薪酬委员会成员调整。
公司于2026年9月9日发布清盘/接管/限制令/特别管理人相关公告。
公司于2026年11月17日发布截至2026年9月30日止季度的合并业绩报告。
risks: 公司于2026年9月9日发布清盘/接管/限制令/特别管理人相关公告，具体内容需进一步查阅。
公司近期出现多名董事及委员会成员变动，可能影响管理层稳定性。
earnings: 截至2026年6月30日止季度，公司营收为39,430,000令吉，环比下降0.5%，同比增长53.0%；净利为2,404,000令吉，环比增长8.5%，同比增长134.5%；净利率为6.1%，高于上一季度的5.6%。

recent_en: West River Berhad has made several announcements recently, including quarterly results, changes in board and committee members, and a winding-up/receivership related announcement. In the news, the company indicated a focus on higher-margin contracts.
notable_en: On 1 September 2026, the company announced multiple changes in directors and committee members, including appointment of new directors and adjustments to audit, nomination, and remuneration committees.
On 9 September 2026, the company released an announcement related to winding-up/receivership/restraining order/special administrator.
On 17 November 2026, the company released its consolidated quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026.
risks_en: On 9 September 2026, the company released an announcement related to winding-up/receivership/restraining order/special administrator; details require further review.
The company recently experienced multiple changes in directors and committee members, which may affect management stability.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR 39,430,000, down 0.5% QoQ but up 53.0% YoY; net income was MYR 2,404,000, up 8.5% QoQ and up 134.5% YoY; net margin was 6.1%, higher than 5.6% in the previous quarter.
